Name: Potato Chivda
Description: Experience the authentic taste of India with Our Potato Chivda. Indulge in the rich flavours and irresistible crunch that make this savoury snack an audience favourite. Treat yourself to the ultimate snacking experience with Potato Chivda and enjoy the true taste of potato.

Name: Special Burfi Combo
Description: Perfect for gifting or enjoying with family and friends, Our Special Burfi Combo promises to elevate your celebrations with its irresistible sweetness and impeccable quality. Treat yourself and your loved ones to this exquisite assortment and experience the true essence of Indian sweets with Annapoorna.

Name: Shankarpali
Description: Experience the delightful crunch and irresistible sweetness of Our Shankarpali, a beloved Maharashtrian treat that captures the essence of traditional Indian sweets. Each piece of Shankarpali is made from a rich dough infused with aromatic spices, meticulously rolled out and cut into bite-sized squares before being deep-fried to golden perfection.

Name: Patal Poha Chivda
Description: Experience the delightful crunch and irresistible flavours of Maharashtra with Our Patal Poha Chivda. Handcrafted using the finest quality flattened rice (poha), this savoury snack is infused with a blend of spices, nuts, and dried fruits, creating a harmonious balance of sweet, salty, and spicy flavours in every bite.

Name: Kesar Kaju Katli
Description: Our Kesar Kaju Katl is a royal indulgence that epitomises the richness of Indian sweets. Crafted with the finest cashews and infused with the delicate flavour of saffron, experience the luxurious melt-in-your-mouth texture of Kaju Katli complemented by the subtle notes of saffron.

Name: Puranpoli (4 piece)
Description: Savour the soft, pillowy texture of the outer dough embracing a sweet and flavorful filling made from lentils, jaggery, and fragrant spices like cardamom and nutmeg. With every bite, experience a symphony of tastes that transport you to the heart of Maharashtra's culinary heritage. Enjoy this delicacy with the richness of mini ghee.

Name: Motichoor Ladoo
Description: Indulge into the deliciousness of our Motichoor Ladoo. Perfect for celebrating or for any special occasion, our Motichoor Ladoo will surely leave you wanting for more. These melt-in-your-mouth delights are made from fine besan flour, sweetened with sugar and are incredibly tasty.

Name: Kaju Badam Roll
Description: Experience the velvety smoothness of cashew paste delicately wrapped around whole almonds, creating a delightful contrast of textures in  Kaju Badam Roll. Enhanced with just the right amount of sweetness this exquisite delicacy promises to elevate any occasion with its blend of tradition and sophistication.

Name: Malai Mysore Pak
Description: Malai Mysore Pak is a luxurious indulgence that combines the rich flavours of malai (cream) with the melt-in-your-mouth goodness of Mysore Pak. Each bite of  Malai Mysore Pak is a symphony of textures. Treat yourself to the ultimate delicacy and experience the taste of pure bliss.

Description: Savour the exquisite flavour of Chitale Bandhu Kaju Katli, a timeless Indian delicacy meticulously crafted to perfection. Made from premium cashew nuts, this confectionary masterpiece is a symphony of rich flavours and velvety textures. It's the perfect indulgence for any occasion.

Name: Mango Burfi
Description: No matter where you go around the world, you will find people who love the Chitale Mango Burfi! Enjoy the creamy and rich flavour of our famous Amba Burfi and experience the heaven of every Mango lover.
